descriptions.default: Two shops are here. This is the Northwest corner of the town of Sandpoint's Town Square.
descriptions.goblin_raid: Chaos reigns, panicked festival-goers careen about to and fro. One merchant stall of a pair set in front of their respective buildings has been upended here amidst the fracas.
descriptions.swallowtail_festival: The Swallowtail Festival is in full swing. Crowds meander to and fro. There are two merchant stalls set in front of their respective buildings here, hoping to attract passers by.

descriptions.default: There are tables set out for folks to eat here.
descriptions.goblin_raid: Chaos reigns, panicked festival-goers careen about in full panic. A table has been knocked over, food spilling onto the ground.
descriptions.swallowtail_festival: The Swallowtail Festival is in full swing. Festival-goers enjoy food nearby.

descriptions.default: There is an exit into the town streets here, and the low wall of the Cathedral grounds to the east.
descriptions.goblin_raid: Chaos reigns, panicked festival-goers careen about in a panic! A mob is bottle-necking at the nearby egress into the town proper.
descriptions.swallowtail_festival: The Swallowtail Festival is in full swing, festival-goers come and go through the entrance/exit in this area.

descriptions.default: The western edge of the Town Square. There are merchant stalls setup here.
descriptions.goblin_raid: Chaos reigns! Panicked festival-goers careen and clamber over and through the crowded open-air market space in this area.
descriptions.swallowtail_festival: The Swallowtail Festival is in full swing, and there are more even more merchant stalls crowding the area, festival-goers eagerly squeeze between the stalls perusing the wares.

descriptions.default: The central square is here, a large wide open space for holding events and gatherings.
descriptions.goblin_raid: Chaos reigns! Goblins are underfoot, and the crowd is in full panic mode.
descriptions.swallowtail_festival: The Swallowtail Festival is in full swing. The Grand Stage has been constructed here, dignitaries and entertainers come and go.

descriptions.default: The Cathedral steps are here. It is a majestic entrance, stained glass and marble with wooden doors, the spires towering above.
descriptions.goblin_raid: Chaos reigns! Church staff hurriedly wave panicked festival-goers to safety before slamming the doors shut against the goblin hordes.
descriptions.swallowtail_festival: The Swallowtail Festival is in full swing, passers-by admire the newly completed Cathedral.

descriptions.default: There is an entrance/exit to the town square here.
descriptions.goblin_raid: Chaos reigns! A panicked mob of festival-goers bottlenecks at the corner of the square here.
descriptions.swallowtail_festival: The Swallowtail Festival is in full swing! Festival-goers come and go from the rest of the town.

descriptions.default: There are tables set out for folks to eat here.
descriptions.goblin_raid: Chaos reigns, panicked festival-goers careen about in full panic. A table has been knocked over, food spilling onto the ground.
descriptions.swallowtail_festival: The Swallowtail Festival is in full swing. Festival-goers enjoy food nearby.

descriptions.default: There is an exit into the town here, the low wall of the Cathedral grounds lies to the east.
descriptions.goblin_raid: Chaos reigns! Panicked festival-goers mob about the exit to the town in this area.
descriptions.swallowtail_festival: The Swallowtail festival is in full swing. Festival-goers come and go from the entrance nearby.
